scope.working_tree_status: unavailable: not a git repository at this path
notes: No code, prompts, models, or manifests were modified.

b3_assessment.reason: The frozen candidate pool lacks B3 columns, and the selector backfills defaults (including predicted_preference = 0.0), so the generic ordering is mostly deterministic tie-breaking rather than a real preference signal.

root_causes.title: Request parsing and normalization collapse
mechanism: The novelty detector only recognizes a narrow explicit phrase list.
The request normalizer can collapse intended concepts into weak labels such as tone or numeric ordinals.
Reference and semantic modes can be inferred inconsistently from the same query.

root_causes.title: Reference extraction is overbroad
mechanism: _extract_reference_title matches common prose patterns like 'like' and 'based on'.
Mood language can be promoted to a film reference title and then resolved against TMDB.

root_causes.title: Qualification uses lexical synonym matching as subject evidence
mechanism: _fallback_qualification_output checks overview/candidate text for literal synonym hits.
That can mark shallow lexical overlap as grounded subject matter.
The LLM qualification path exists, but the final records still come from the heuristic fallback.

root_causes.title: B3 feature propagation is incomplete
mechanism: The frozen candidate pool artifact does not carry the B3 prediction columns.
The selector backfills defaults, so B3 does not meaningfully rank the generic slate.
The runtime still narrates B3 as a rationale, but the actual signal is weak or absent.

root_causes.title: Exclusion semantics are not enforced end-to-end
mechanism: Negated concepts are not consistently preserved as hard semantic exclusions.
The qualification/selection chain does not treat them as a single admission barrier across all paths.
Validation exists, but the upstream semantics are already inconsistent by the time it runs.
